children: Urban One's revenue fell 5.0% year over year as declines in Digital and Cable Television more than offset higher Radio Broadcasting revenue; net loss attributable to common stockholders widened, mainly reflecting $128.9 million in impairment charges, partly offset by lower operating expenses and interest expense.
¹ Reported as “NET REVENUE”. ² Reported as “NET LOSS ATTRIBUTABLE TO COMMON STOCKHOLDERS”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: Segment revenue rose to $36.7 million from $34.7 million, driven by acquired stations and political campaigns, partly offset by weaker advertiser demand.
: Revenue declined to $9.6 million from $12.7 million amid reduced diversity, equity and inclusion-focused spending and lower campaign rates.
: Revenue fell to $37.3 million from $39.8 million, driven by subscriber churn and lower advertising rates.
: Recorded $128.9 million in charges, including $62.5 million for radio broadcasting licenses, $25.4 million for Radio Broadcasting goodwill and $40.9 million for Cable Television goodwill.
: Service Broadcasting stations KKDA and KRNB began contributing results after the July 17 closing.
